headline: Japan Has Not Officially Cleared Deflation, Economy Minister Cautions
summary: Japan's economy minister stated that the country has not yet officially emerged from deflation, maintaining caution regarding the durability of economic and price trends.
why: Official declarations regarding the end of deflation influence the Bank of Japan's interest rate normalization path and the valuation of the Japanese yen.

impacts.name: Japanese Yen
impacts.why: Statements signaling lingering deflationary risks create uncertainty over the pace of central bank rate hikes.
